"""Local-only Runtime API + TLS NuGet fixture. No AWS, RIE, or production traffic."""
import collections
import hashlib
import http.server
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import ssl
import statistics
import subprocess
import threading
import time
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BODY = '{"schemaVersion":1,"label":"nuget","message":"1.2.3","color":"blue","namedLogo":"nuget"}'
TAG = '"' + hashlib.sha256(BODY.encode()).hexdigest().upper() + '"'
CASES = ["NoHeader", "Quoted", "WeakList", "Miss"]
HEADERS = {"NoHeader": {}, "Quoted": {"if-none-match": TAG},
           "WeakList": {"if-none-match": ' \t"different", w/ ' + TAG.lower() + ' , "other" '},
           "Miss": {"if-none-match": '"different", W/"other", unquoted'}}


class QuietHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def setup(self):
        super().setup()
        self.connection.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP, socket.TCP_NODELAY, 1)

    def log_message(self, *_args):
        pass

    def reply(self, status, body=b"", headers=None):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        for key, value in (headers or {}).items():
            self.send_header(key, value)
        self.end_headers()
        if body:
            self.wfile.write(body)
            self.wfile.flush()


class UpstreamHandler(QuietHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path != "/v3-flatcontainer/badgesmith-fixture/index.json":
            self.server.failures.append("unexpected upstream path")
            self.reply(404)
            return
        self.server.requests += 1
        conditional = self.headers.get("If-None-Match") == '"fixture-v1"'
        self.server.statuses[304 if conditional else 200] += 1
        self.reply(304 if conditional else 200,
                   b"" if conditional else b'{"versions":["1.0.0","1.2.3","2.0.0-preview.1"]}',
                   {"ETag": '"fixture-v1"', "Last-Modified": "Fri, 16 Oct 2026 12:00:00 GMT",
                    "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8"})


class RuntimeHandler(QuietHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        state = self.server.state
        if self.path != "/2018-06-01/runtime/invocation/next":
            state["failures"].append("unexpected Runtime API GET")
            self.reply(404)
            return
        if state["readyNs"] is None:
            state["readyNs"] = time.perf_counter_ns()
        index = len(state["results"])
        if index >= len(state["cases"]):
            state["finished"].set()
            state["stop"].wait(10)
            self.close_connection = True
            return
        case = state["cases"][index]
        event = {"version": "2.0", "routeKey": "GET /badges/packages/{provider}/{package}",
                 "rawPath": "/badges/packages/nuget/badgesmith-fixture", "rawQueryString": "",
                 "headers": HEADERS[case], "queryStringParameters": {}, "isBase64Encoded": False,
                 "requestContext": {"requestId": "local-fixture", "stage": "$default",
                                    "http": {"method": "GET", "path": "/badges/packages/nuget/badgesmith-fixture",
                                             "protocol": "HTTP/1.1", "sourceIp": "127.0.0.1", "userAgent": "local-fixture"}}}
        payload = json.dumps(event, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        state["sentNs"] = time.perf_counter_ns()
        self.reply(200, payload, {"Content-Type": "application/json",
                                 "Lambda-Runtime-Aws-Request-Id": f"local-{index}",
                                 "Lambda-Runtime-Deadline-Ms": str(int(time.time() * 1000) + 30000),
                                 "Lambda-Runtime-Invoked-Function-Arn": "arn:aws:lambda:eu-central-1:000000000000:function:local-fixture"})

    def do_POST(self):
        state = self.server.state
        elapsed = time.perf_counter_ns() - state["sentNs"]
        payload = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0)))
        index = len(state["results"])
        if self.path != f"/2018-06-01/runtime/invocation/local-{index}/response":
            state["failures"].append("unexpected Runtime API POST/error")
        try:
            response = json.loads(payload)
            case = state["cases"][index]
            expected_status = 304 if case in ("Quoted", "WeakList") else 200
            headers = {key.lower(): value for key, value in response["headers"].items()}
            assert response["statusCode"] == expected_status
            assert response.get("body") == (None if expected_status == 304 else BODY)
            assert headers["etag"] == TAG
            assert headers["cache-control"] == "public, s-maxage=600, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=1200, stale-if-error=3600"
            assert headers["last-modified"] == "Fri, 16 Oct 2026 12:00:00 GMT"
            assert headers["content-type"] == "application/json; charset=utf-8"
            state["results"].append({"case": case, "elapsedNs": elapsed, "statusCode": expected_status})
        except (ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, AssertionError):
            state["failures"].append("native response contract mismatch")
            state["finished"].set()
        self.reply(202)


def hwm_kib(pid):
    for line in Path(f"/proc/{pid}/status").read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith("VmHWM:"):
            return int(line.split()[1])
    raise AssertionError("missing native process HWM")


def launch(variant, launch_index):
    upstream = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), UpstreamHandler)
    upstream.requests, upstream.statuses, upstream.failures = 0, collections.Counter(), []
    tls = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
    tls.load_cert_chain(ROOT / "fixture-cert.pem", ROOT / "fixture-key.pem")
    upstream.socket = tls.wrap_socket(upstream.socket, server_side=True)
    runtime = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), RuntimeHandler)
    state = {"readyNs": None, "sentNs": 0, "results": [], "failures": [],
             "cases": ["NoHeader"] + CASES * (4 + 32),
             "stop": threading.Event(), "finished": threading.Event()}
    runtime.state = state
    threads = [threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True) for server in (upstream, runtime)]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    env = {"PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "HOME": str(ROOT / "empty-home"),
           "TMPDIR": str(ROOT / "tmp"), "DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT": "Production",
           "AWS_LAMBDA_RUNTIME_API": f"127.0.0.1:{runtime.server_port}",
           "AWS_REGION": "eu-central-1", "AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED": "true",
           "AWS_CONFIG_FILE": "/dev/null", "AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE": "/dev/null",
           "AWS_ENDPOINT_URL": f"http://127.0.0.1:{runtime.server_port}",
           "BADGESMITH_UPSTREAM_MODE": "Live",
           "HTTP_NUGET_BASE_URL": f"https://127.0.0.1:{upstream.server_port}/",
           "HTTP_GITHUB_BASE_URL": f"https://127.0.0.1:{upstream.server_port}/",
           "SSL_CERT_FILE": str(ROOT / "fixture-cert.pem")}
    started = time.perf_counter_ns()
    process = subprocess.Popen([str(ROOT / f"native-{variant}" / "bootstrap")], env=env,
                               stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        assert state["finished"].wait(30), "native launch timed out"
        assert not state["failures"], ";".join(state["failures"])
        assert not upstream.failures
        assert len(state["results"]) == len(state["cases"])
        assert upstream.requests == len(state["cases"]), "upstream revalidation was skipped"
        assert upstream.statuses == {200: 1, 304: len(state["cases"]) - 1}
        return {"variant": variant, "launch": launch_index,
                "readyNs": state["readyNs"] - started,
                "firstInvokeNs": state["results"][0]["elapsedNs"],
                "processHighWaterKiB": hwm_kib(process.pid),
                "upstreamRequests": upstream.requests, "upstreamStatuses": dict(upstream.statuses),
                "warmInvocations": state["results"][17:], "contractChecksPassed": True}
    finally:
        process.terminate()
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.kill()
            process.wait(timeout=5)
        state["stop"].set()
        for server in (runtime, upstream):
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join(timeout=5)


def summary(values, scale=1):
    values = sorted(value / scale for value in values)
    return {"n": len(values), "min": min(values), "median": statistics.median(values),
            "p95NearestRank": values[(95 * len(values) + 99) // 100 - 1], "max": max(values)}


def main():
    for variant in ("before", "after"):
        destination = ROOT / f"native-{variant}"
        destination.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(ROOT / f"aot-{variant}" / "badge-lambda-linux-x64.zip") as archive:
            assert archive.namelist() == ["bootstrap"] and archive.testzip() is None
            data = archive.read("bootstrap")
            assert data.startswith(b"\x7fELF")
            executable = destination / "bootstrap"
            executable.write_bytes(data)
            executable.chmod(0o755)
    rows = []
    for index in range(8):
        for variant in (("before", "after") if index % 2 == 0 else ("after", "before")):
            row = launch(variant, index)
            rows.append(row)
            print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "warmInvocations"}), flush=True)
    result = {"kind": "local-x64-native-aot-runtime-api-tls-fixture-not-aws-init-or-cloudwatch-memory",
              "launchOrder": "AB,BA repeated four times", "launches": rows, "summary": {}}
    for variant in ("before", "after"):
        subset = [row for row in rows if row["variant"] == variant]
        result["summary"][variant] = {
            "processToFirstRuntimeGetMs": summary([row["readyNs"] for row in subset], 1e6),
            "firstInvokeRoundTripMs": summary([row["firstInvokeNs"] for row in subset], 1e6),
            "processHighWaterKiB": summary([row["processHighWaterKiB"] for row in subset]),
            "warmRuntimeRoundTripMs": {case: summary([invocation["elapsedNs"] for row in subset
                                                      for invocation in row["warmInvocations"] if invocation["case"] == case], 1e6)
                                       for case in CASES}}
    (ROOT / "native-comparison.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(result["summary"], indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
